instruction: Enable line numbering for the entire document

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling line numbering for the document. The evaluator checks if the lnNumType XML element exists in the section properties, which indicates line numbering is enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: The metric correctly checks for line numbering by looking for the lnNumType XML element in section properties, which is the correct approach for .docx files
The postconfig properly saves the document before verification, ensuring state persistence

Instruction says 'entire document' but the metric returns 1.0 if ANY section has line numbering enabled - for multi-section documents, this could pass even if line numbering is not enabled for all sections
Most LibreOffice documents have a single section, so this would work correctly in typical cases
The metric only checks for element existence, not whether line numbering is actually enabled (though in practice, the element's presence usually indicates it's enabled)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking ALL sections have line numbering enabled, not just any section, to match the 'entire document' requirement
Optionally verify the lnNumType element's attributes to confirm line numbering is actually enabled, not just that the element exists
